answer: We propose a mechanism where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds impose a non-linear signal of capital lock-up, effectively rendering Sybil multiplication a subgame-perfect trap. As the vine of agent identities grows, each node incurs a crystal clear marginal cost that exceeds expected utility, driving the payoff to a negative limit. Consequently, the unique Nash equilibrium converges to a state where individual honesty is the dominant strategy, ensuring robust network security.
